title: PF001AutonomousListenerObservation
description: Standardized autonomous observation schema for PF-001A. Records corpus-observable structures, transformations, counterfactual perturbations, multi-scale structural representations, and internal Listener state trajectories without requiring human participant data.

piece_id.description: Canonical piece identifier within the classical corpus.

source_id.description: Identifier for the underlying symbolic score edition or recording.

segment_id.description: Identifier for the musical segment, measure range, or structural block.

motif_id.description: Thematic or motivic identifier if the unit tracks an identified motif; null otherwise.

event_index.description: Sequential integer index of the symbolic event.

beat_position.description: Metrical beat position within the piece/measure.

timescale.description: Hierarchical musical timescale of the representation.

input_context_span.description: Context span in events or quarter-notes provided to the model.

target_event.description: Symbolic token, pitch class, sonority, or feature vector of the target continuation event.

target_boundary.description: Corpus-observable structural boundary label if present; null otherwise.

transformation_id.description: Identifier of controlled morphological transformation applied, if any.

is_identity_preserving.description: Ground-truth structural designation whether transformation preserves motif identity.

perturbation_id.description: Identifier of counterfactual perturbation test, if any.

perturbation_strength.description: Quantitative magnitude or parameter of the applied perturbation.

structural_expectation.description: Model conditional predictive distribution P(x_{t+1} | x_{<=t}) over structural continuation candidates.

structural_uncertainty.description: Shannon entropy H[P(x_{t+1} | x_{<=t})] in bits.

structural_closure.description: Predicted structural boundary probability C_s(t) in [0.0, 1.0].

motif_identity_score.description: Cosine similarity or metric distance between motif representation z(M) and z(T(M)).

structural_memory_trace.description: Structural activation trace m_k(t) = similarity(z(M_k), h_t) of motif k in working/long-range memory buffer.

split_id.description: Generalization partition assignment enforcing strict composer isolation.

corpus_version.description: Hash or version tag of the underlying classical corpus dataset.

feature_version.description: Version string of the symbolic feature extractor pipeline.

model_version.description: Version identifier of the Artificial Listener model.
